mostWorthwhile.text: Adding glucose was most worthwhile: the planned picture connects transporter binding and release to net entry down a concentration difference.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the transporter was the least engaging passage on its own: its two poses were suggestive, but the result offered no explanation beyond the picture. Each decision also had only one combination, so there was little meaningful choice.

surprise.text: The membrane picture showed glucose crossing very slowly, giving a clear reason for the transporter rather than treating the membrane as an absolute barrier.

arbitrary.text: No action felt arbitrary; the goal and pictures gave each combination a clear purpose. The compatible options were supplied, though, so I did not discover the recipes myself.

continue.text: I would probably continue to see how the cell connects to larger body functions, though I would hope for more meaningful choices. The planned pictures and brief explanations seem useful for this audience, but they do not establish student comprehension.
